title: Windows B TermAl runner layout is invalid for gates: deep clone path exceeds Windows path limits and sits under a 'target' ancestor (1273 environment failures)
outcome: Windows B can run TermAl full and focused gates whose results reflect the input, not the runner layout. The clone and job worktrees live at a short path with no component named target (or any other watcher-ignored name), inside the runner's write scope, git-ignored and protected from Engram cleanup. Per-job TEMP is short, and a known-good input passes the full gate there.
acceptance: Windows B TermAl runner layout is invalid for gates: deep clone path exceeds Windows path limits and sits under a 'target' ancestor (1273 environment failures) is done
